eventDetail.keywords: Internet of Things, Wireless Communications, Computer Networks, Artificial Intelligence, Communications And Networking, Communication System Security,
eventDetail.scope: NextGCom 2026 will be divided into 6 Tracks designed to cover cutting-edge advancements and innovations in communication technologies. These Tracks span topics from physical layer techniques and MAC protocols to AI-driven communication solutions and cybersecurity strategies. Additionally, the conference will explore IoT applications, real-world testbeds, and business perspectives, fostering a comprehensive dialogue on next-generation networks.
